visits.transcript: Good morning, Mr. Venkatesh. Please sit down. How have you been since the last visit? Good morning, doctor. I have been fine mostly but I get a mild headache in the mornings hyphen slash maybe three days in a week. I see, are you checking your blood pressure at home, as I had asked? Yes doctor. My son bought a machine. Every morning before tea I check it. The reading is around 150 over 94 on most days. That is still higher than where we want it. Today in the clinic it is 148 over 92. Your pulse is 78 and regular. I was afraid it would be high. I had pickles and papa at my cousin's wedding last week. Salt is a big part of this, so please keep that down. Tell me, are you taking Telma 40 milligrams every day without missing? Yes, one tablet every morning after breakfast. Maybe I missed it twice this month when we traveled. Okay, any swelling in the feet, cough, or dizziness when you stand up? No swelling. No cough. Sometimes a little dizzy if I get up fast from the sofa. That is good to know. Since the pressure is still high on one medicine, I am going to add a second one. I am starting amlodipine 5 milligrams, 1 tablet at night. At night, after dinner. Yes, after dinner is fine. It can cause a little ankle swelling in some people. So tell me if you notice that. Okay, doctor. And the telma continues as before. Continue Telma 40 milligrams in the morning. Do not stop it on your own even if the readings look good. Understood. Should I continue the aspirin also? The one my cardiologist gave. You mean ecosprint 75 milligrams? Yes, continue that once a day after lunch. It protects your heart. And the stomach upset you had earlier has settled. So we do not need to change it. And the cholesterol tablet, atovastatin. Continue atovastatin 10 milligrams at bedtime. I want to check your numbers, so I am ordering a fasting lipid profile. Please do it after 10 to 12 hours of fasting. Can I take my medicines on the morning of the test? Yes, take the telma with a sip of water. Only skip your break fast and tea until the blood is drawn. Okay, what should my home readings be? Aim for below 130 over 80. Write down the morning and evening readings for one week and bring the diary with you. I will ask my wife to write it in the notebook. She is more regular than I am. That is a good idea. Also, walk for 30 minutes daily and reduce papad, pickle, and packet snacks. I walk in the park near the lake. I will try to go every day, not only on Sundays. Good. If you ever get chaste pain, severe headache, or sudden weakness on one side, do not wait for the appointment. Go to the emergency room immediately. Yes, doctor, I understand. Let me also check your kidney function in the same sample. Since two blood pressure medicines can affect it, I will add a serum creatinine to the form. Fine, when should I come back? Come back in 4 weeks with the lipid report and the diary. If the pressure is controlled, we will not add anything more. Thank you, doctor. Shall I take the new tablet from today? Yes, from tonight. Amlodipine 5 milligrams after dinner. Telma 40 milligrams in the morning. Ecosprin 75 milligrams after lunch, and Atovastatin 10 milligrams at bedtime. Is that clear? Yes, 4 tablets at 4 different times. I will keep the pillbox ready. Perfect. The pharmacy downstairs has everything. Take care, Mr. Venkatesh, and see you in 4 weeks. Thank you, Doctor. Goodbye.

Good afternoon, Miss Ace Lakshmi, please come in. Your reports came this morning, so let us go through them. Good afternoon, doctor. I was a bit nervous about the sugar levels this time. Your HBA1C is 8.2%, 3 months ago it was 7.4, so it has gone up, and we need to understand why. Doctor, there were many festivals, sweets at home every day for 2 weeks, and I stopped my walks because of the rain. That explains a part of it. Your fasting sugar today is 146 and the aftermeal reading is 228. Are you taking your tablets regularly? Mostly yes. Metformin I take twice a day, the small one glimepiride, I sometimes skip if I am not eating on time. Please do not skip it without telling me, but you are right to be careful. Have you had any episodes of sweating, shaking, or sudden hunger? Twice last month in the afternoon, I felt shaky and I ate a bisque and it passed. That is a low sugar episode, and glimpiride can cause it if you delay meals, so I am going to change the plan a little. Will I have to take insulin? No, not at all, we are not there. We will first adjust the tablets, continue metformin 500 milligrams twice a day, after break fast and after dinner. Okay, same as now. Yes, now the glimepiride 1 milligram, I want you to take only with the break fast, never on an empty stomach, and only if you are going to eat within half an hour. Okay, I will remember that. And I am adding genuvia 50 milligrams, 1 tablet once a day in the morning, it lowers the sugar without causing lows, so it is a safer partner for the metformin. Is it expensive, doctor? My son pays for the medicines now. It costs more than the older tablets. Yes, a generic of the same salt, citagliptin, is available at a lower price. I will write the salt name so the pharmacist can give you the cheaper one. That will help. Thank you. Your cholesterol was also on the higher side, LDL is 118. Are you still taking the Rasuvastatin? Yes, one at night. Continue Rosuvastatin 10 milligrams at night. For the tingling in your feet that you mentioned last time, I will give Bicajules one capsule daily after lunch for one month. The tingling is worse at night. Is it because of the sugar? It can be. Let me examine your feet. Please take off your sandals. I am checking the pulses and sensation with this small monofilament. Tell me when you feel it. Yes, yes. I feel it on the left, on the right big toe, it is less. Slightly reduced sensation on the right, no wounds or cracks, which is good. Please check your feet every night and never walk barefoot at home. I always walk barefoot in the puja room. Wear soft cha pulse even there. Now, about food, reduce white rice to one small bowl, add more dull and vegetables, and no sweets except once a week. My daughter-in-law will help me plan the meals. Good. Walk for 30 minutes after dinner, even inside the house if it rains. I will also send your urine for microalbumin, to check that the kidneys are not affected. When should I do the blood test again? Repeat the HBA1C after 3 months. Come to see me after 1 month with a log of fasting and after-meal sugars, 2 days a week is enough. Okay, doctor. So metformin twice a day, glimapiride with breakfast, genuvia in the morning, rosovastatin at night, and becosules after lunch. That is exactly right. Well done. If your sugar goes below 70 or you feel shaky, eat something sweet at once and call the clinic. I will, thank you very much, doctor.

Hello, please come in and sit. This is Aruv, right? He is how old now? Yes, doctor. He is 5 years old. He has had fever for 3 days and he is not eating anything. 3 days? What is the highest temperature you have measured? Yesterday night it was 102.5. In the mornings it comes down to 100, but by evening it goes up again. Any cough, running nose, ear pain, or loose motions? A little cough and he vomited twice yesterday. No loose motions. He complains that his throat hurts when he swallows. Okay, is he passing urine normally? When did he last pass urine? About 4 hours ago. He is drinking very little water, doctor only some juice. Let me examine him. Aruv, open your mouth and say ah. The throat is red and the tonsils are swollen with a few white spots. His temperature right now is 101.4 and his weight is 18 kilograms. Is it a viral fever or an infection? The white spots on the tonsils and the high fever suggest a bacterial throat infection. Lungs are clear, ears are normal and the belly is soft. There is no ration, no neck stiffness. That is a relief. What should we give him? For fever, give paracetamol 250 milligrams, which is 5 milliliters of the syrup. Every 6 hours only if the temperature is above 100. Do not give more than 4 doses in a day. I gave him crocin drops yesterday. Is it the same? Same medicine but the drops are more concentrated. Please Uzth Syrap I am writing so that dose is craked for his weight. Okay, doctor. For the vomiting I am giving Andancitron 2 milligrams, half a tablet dissolved on the tongue, only when he feels like vomiting, up to twice a day for 2 days. And an antibiotic? Yes, amoxicillin 250 milligrams, 1 dose 3 times a day for 5 days. Please complete the full course, even if the fever goes away by the second day. Before food or after food? After food or with a few biscuits, so that the stomach does not get upset. Shake the bottle well each time. Understood. He refuses to drink water. What can I do? Dehydration is the main worry. Give ORS one small cup after every vomit or every hour in small sips. Coconut water, rice kanji, and dilute buttermilk are also fine. Should I do a cold sponge when the fever is high? Use a lukewarm cloth, not cold water, and dress him in light cotton clothes. Please deo not cover him with blankets. Because he has had three days of fever, I would like to send a complete blood count just to be sure that there is no other infection. Can we do it today? Yes, the lab is on the ground floor. The report will be ready in two hours and you can show me on the phone. Okay, when do we bring him back if he does not improve? If the fever continues beyond tomorrow evening, come back. Come at once if he becomes very sleepy, refuses all fluids, passes no urine for 8 hours has fits, or develops a rash. Yes, doctor. Can he go to school? Not for 3 days. He should be fever-free for a full day before he goes back. I will write a certificate for the school. Thank you, Doctor. Arav, say thank you. Bye, Arav. Rest well, drink plenty, and I will see you after the blood test.

Good morning, Mr. Prakash. It is 10 days since your gallbladder surgery. How are you feeling? Good morning, doctor. Much better. The pain has reduced a lot, but the right side of the belly still pulls when I bend. That is normal at this stage. Let me see the wound. Please lie down and lift your shirt. The three small cuts are clean and dry. There is no redness and no discharge. The stitches are dissolving on their own. The one near the navel was a little wet for two days, but now it is dry. Yes, it has healed. Any fever since you went home? No fever. I checked every evening as the nurse told me. Good. How is your appetite, and are your motions normal? Appetite is better. I had some loose motions for two days after the surgery, but it is regular now. That can happen after the gallbladder is removed, and it usually settles. Are you still taking the antibiotic? Yes, suffixine 200 milligrams twice a day. Today is the last day, I think. That is right. Finish Sefixine 200 milligrams today, and then stop. No further antibiotic is needed. And the pain tablet, Tramadol. I took it only at night. Let us stop Tramadol 50 milligrams now. It makes you drowsy and constipated, and your pain is mild. If you need something, take Dolo 650 milligrams, one tablet up to three times a day after food. Okay, can I take Dolo on an empty stomach? It is better after food. Also, continue Pantoprazole 40 milligrams every morning 30 minutes before break fast for two more weeks to protect the stomach. Should I continue my diabetes tablets also? Yes, continue everything else as before. I have reviewed the list in your discharge summary and there is no clash with the new medicines. When can I start eating normally? My wife is asking about the Gian fried food. For the first month, keep the food light and low in oil. Small meals 4 or 5 times a day instead of 2 big meals. Fried items and sweets can come back slowly after that. What about lifting weights? I have to carry the water cans at home. Please do not lift anything heavier than 3 or 4 kilograms for 6 weeks. Ask someone to help you with the cans. Walking is good, and you can climb stairs slowly. When can I go back to the office? It is a desk job. Since it is a desk job, you can resume a after 2 more weeks. Start with half days if you feel tired. Driving is fine once you can press the brake hard without any pain. Understood. Is there anything I should watch for? Come at once if you have fever above 101. Yellow color of the eyes or urine. Severe pain. Vomiting that will not stop or pass from any of the wounds. I will remember that. The pathology report on the gallbladder is normal, which is good news. Just one more thing. I want an ultrasound of the abdomen after a month to confirm that everything inside has healed well. Do I need to be fasting for the ultrasound? Yes, 6 hours of fasting, and come with a full bladder. The radiology desk will give you a slot. Thank you, Doctor. So to summarize, finish suffixine today, stop tramadol, dolo 650 if there is pain, and pantoprazole 40 for 2 more weeks. Perfect summary. See me again in a month with the ultrasound report. Take care. Thank you, Doctor. Goodbye.

Good evening, Mr. Srinivasan. Please sit here and keep your chin on the rest. What brings you in today? Good evening, doctor. My eyes feel dry and gritty, especially in the evenings, and I have blurred vision while reading the newspaper. How many hours do you spend on the computer or the phone in a day? Nearly 9 hours at work, and then another 2 at home. I rarely take breaks. That explains the dryness. Do you remember your last eye pressure reading? You were told about glaucoma in the family. My father had glaucoma. My own pressure was borderline 2 years ago. I did not follow up. I am sorry. Let us check it today then. Look straight ahead. I will use the airpuff device. Right eye is 21 and left eye is 23. These are at the upper limit of normal. Is that dangerous? Not by itself, but with your family history ideal, not what to ignore it. I will dilate your eyes and look at the optic nerve. The drops will blur your vision for 4 to 5 hours, so please do not drive afterwards. My driver is waiting outside, so it is fine. Good. Look up now, and down. The optic nerve cup looks slightly enlarged in the left eye. The retina is healthy and there is no diabetic change. What does that mean for me? It means you are a glaucoma suspect. We should confirm it with a visual field test and a scan of the nerve fiber layer, which I will book for this week. Will I need drops every day? Possibly. For now, I am starting Timol 0.5% eye drops, one drop in both eyes twice a day, morning and evening. Press the corner of the eye for a minute after putting the drop. Why do I need to press the corner? So that less of the medicine drains into your nose and body. Timolol can slow the heart, so tell me if you feel breathless or your pulse becomes very slow. Do you have asthma? No asthma. Pulse is usually around 70. Guga, if the field test confirms glaucoma, we will switch to litanoprost 0.005% one drop at bedtime, which is stronger. I will decide that at the next visit. Okay, and the dryness? For that, use carboxymethylcellus 0.5% lubricating drops, 1 drop in each eye 4 times a day. Wait 5 minutes between this and the Timolol. I used to take some red eye whitening drops from the shop. Should I stop them? Please stop those. They can raise the pressure in some people and make dryness worse. Also follow the 2020 rule. Every 20 minutes look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds. I will set a reminder on my phone. Your left eyelid margin is also slightly inflamed with some crusting. I am giving a short course on moxifloxacin 0.5% drops, 1 drop in the left eye 3 times a day for 5 days and a warm compress for 10 minutes each morning. Is that an infection? It is mild blepharitis which is common with dry eyes. The warm compress is as important as the drops. What about my reading glasses? I feel that the number has changed. Your near vision needs plus 1.75 now, up from plus 1.25. I will give you a new prescription after the dilation wears off, and I suggest an anti-glare coating. Fine, when should I come back? Come on Friday for the visual field test and the nerve scan, and then to see me again. Do not miss it this time. Glaucoma damage is silent and permanent. I will be there. Thank you, Doctor. Guga, Timolol twice a day, lubricating drops four times a day, and moxifloxacin in the left eye for five days. See you on Friday.
